name: zovo-markdown-export
displayName: Markdown Export to PDF & Word (DOCX, HTML, No Chromium Download)
description: Export Markdown to PDF, Word (DOCX) and HTML with the Chrome, Edge or Brave you already have. Nothing to download, works offline. Math, Mermaid, code colours, tables, footnotes, headers, page numbers and a table of contents. Built-in PDF engine when no browser is installed.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted folder, the workspace values of Word template and output folder are ignored. Your own user settings still apply.

commands.title: Export to PDF, Word and HTML
Export Every Markdown File in a Folder...
Merge a Folder into One PDF (Pro)
Get Zovo Pro (USD 19 once, all Zovo extensions)
Unlock Zovo Pro with GitHub Sponsors
Remove Zovo Pro from This Editor

enumDescriptions: Use the Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium on this computer; the built-in engine when there is none.
Always use an installed browser. Show an error when none is found.
Always use the built-in engine (simpler layout, no Mermaid drawings).
markdownExport.pdfEngine.description: How PDFs are made. Nothing is ever downloaded.

markdownExport.browserPath.description: Full path of a Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium program to print PDFs with. Empty: found automatically in the usual install folders.

markdownExport.outputFolder.description: Where exported files go. Empty: next to the Markdown file. A relative path is relative to the Markdown file. ${workspaceFolder} and ${fileDirname} work.

markdownExport.pageSize.description: Paper size for PDF and Word. Front matter `pageSize:` overrides it per file.

markdownExport.landscape.description: Landscape pages. Front matter `landscape: true` overrides it per file.

markdownExport.margin.description: Page margins: one value for all sides, or top right bottom left (for example "20mm" or "15mm 20mm"). Units: mm, cm, in, pt, px.

markdownExport.header.description: Header text on every page. {title}, {date}, {page} and {pages} are filled in. Empty: no header.

markdownExport.footer.description: Footer text on every page. {title}, {date}, {page} and {pages} are filled in. Empty: no footer.

markdownExport.toc.description: Add a table of contents (headings 1 to 3) at the start. Front matter `toc: true` turns it on per file.

markdownExport.fontSize.description: Body text size in points for PDF and Word.

markdownExport.breaks.description: Treat single line breaks in a paragraph as line breaks (like GitHub comments) instead of spaces.

markdownExport.allowRemoteImages.description: Load images from http and https addresses into exports. Off: the extension makes no network request at all and remote images show as their alt text.

enumDescriptions: Follows the reader's light or dark system setting.
markdownExport.htmlTheme.description: Colours of the exported HTML file.

markdownExport.mermaidTheme.description: Mermaid diagram colours in PDF, Word and HTML.

markdownExport.fallbackFont.description: A .ttf or .otf font file for characters Roboto lacks (CJK, Arabic, symbols) in the built-in PDF engine. Empty: a system font is found when there is one.

enumDescriptions: Show a message with Open and Show in Folder buttons.
Open the file in its default app.

markdownExport.maxFileMB.description: Files larger than this ask before they are exported.

markdownExport.showTitleButton.description: Show the export button in the editor title bar of Markdown files.

markdownExport.docxTemplate.description: (Pro) A .docx or .dotx file whose styles Word exports use (fonts, heading colours, spacing). Front matter `docxTemplate:` overrides it per file.

markdownExport.showProFeatures.description: Show the Zovo Pro extras (Merge a Folder into One PDF) and the Zovo Pro commands. Off hides them from menus and the Command Palette. Every PDF, Word and HTML export stays free either way.

markdownExport.coverPage.description: (Pro) Start PDF, Word and HTML exports with a cover page made from the front matter title, subtitle, author and date. Front matter `cover: true` turns it on per file.

markdownExport.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after successful exports in 2 sessions at least 4 hours apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

markdownExport.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free tools and Sponsor links at the bottom of the Export Preview. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Markdown Export
walkthroughs.description: Turn Markdown into PDF, Word and HTML with the browser you already have. Nothing to download.

steps.title: Export the open file
steps.description:
Open a Markdown file and click the export button in the editor title bar (or press Cmd+Alt+E / Ctrl+Alt+E). Pick PDF, Word or HTML.
[Find a Markdown file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.md%22%5D)

media.altText: The export menu over a Markdown file with PDF, Word, HTML and all three.

steps.title: Check the pages first
steps.description:
The Export Preview shows the document on paper, with the page size and margins of the PDF.
[Open Export Preview](command:markdownExport.showPreview)

steps.title: No download, no network
steps.description:
PDFs come from the Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium on this computer. Without one, the built-in engine makes a simpler PDF. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is sent.
[Which engine is used?](command:markdownExport.showEngine)

steps.title: Paper, margins, header and footer
steps.description:
Set the page size, margins, header, footer and table of contents for all files, or per file in front matter.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22markdownExport%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
